name: smwgraphics-castlevania-harmony-of-dissonance-luminous-cavern
title: Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance - Luminous Cavern
description:
The background seen in the Luminous Cave from Castlevania: Harmony of Dissonance. Includes both versions: Castle A version (blue) and Castle B version (purple). Does not include the flashing palette due to the difficulty and complexity of ripping it. A great fit for cave levels.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
